finding.sink: determine_depth recursion during validation, before execution

finding.claim: WebSocket endpoints perform no Origin check, so a cross-site page can open a socket that carries victim cookies and run queries, mutations and subscriptions as the victim, reading the responses (cross-site WebSocket hijacking). Conditional on cookie-based auth in get_context/on_ws_connect.
finding.source: JavaScript on attacker page opening wss:// to the victim's GraphQL endpoint; browser attaches session cookies
finding.sink: Operation execution as victim via graphql-transport-ws / graphql-ws handlers

trace.note: handle_connection_init accepts connection; only app on_ws_connect hook runs

finding.guards_checked: Grep of strawberry/ found no origin/Origin check in any framework adapter; only app-supplied on_ws_connect hook, which is not an Origin check by default

finding.sink: Module-level lru_cache(maxsize=None) growing for process lifetime

trace.note: same pattern for validation, keyed by document
